business_problem: Wellverse sales teams faced manual work, handoffs, and time-consuming product-catalog searches when preparing quotes for health-system customers and translating product information into customer value propositions.
solution_summary: KPMG describes an agentic sales and quoting solution built with Salesforce Agentforce and Google Gemini. The agent is embedded in the seller's sales experience and uses Gemini as an intelligence layer over product information, item inventory, pricing, quotes, and competitive market intelligence. It automates catalog research and translates the resulting information into a competitive quote and a customer-specific value proposition, while keeping the workflow in one sales environment rather than requiring sellers to move between tools. The source presents the solution as an implemented Wellverse customer success story but does not identify the underlying data stores, quote system, integration products, or reported quantitative outcomes. It emphasizes reduced manual work and faster quote preparation rather than providing a measured deployment result.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Agentforce
solution_components.role: Provides the agent embedded in the seller's sales workflow.

solution_components.name: Google Gemini
solution_components.role: Interprets catalog, inventory, pricing, and competitive information to help create quotes.

solution_components.name: KPMG sales and quoting solution
solution_components.role: Coordinates the sales workflow and presents quote recommendations and value propositions to representatives.

data_flow: Product catalog, inventory, price, quote, and market information are provided to Gemini through the sales agent; the resulting competitive quote and supporting value proposition are presented to the seller in the sales experience.
business_outcome: The solution is intended to reduce manual catalog research and handoffs so sales representatives can prepare competitive quotes faster and focus on customer problem-solving; the page provides no measured customer results.
